messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若您想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議參考以下幾個常用來源：

| 資料來源 | 取得方式 | 特色 |
|----------|----------|------|
| Bloomberg、Reuters | 網站或手機 App | 提供即時行情、歷史走勢與新聞 |
| Kitco、GoldPrice.org | 網站 | 專門報導黃金、白銀等貴金屬價格 |
| 美國商品期貨交易所（CME） | 官方網站 | 期貨合約價格與成交量 |
| 金管局或金融監管機構 | 官方公告 | 主要用於政策與監管資訊 |

您可以在這些平台上查看「Spot Gold」或「黃金即期價格」的最新報價，通常以美元/盎司（USD/oz）為單位。若您需要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述網站或使用相關金融 App。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can provide a typical price or explain that we can't fetch live data. We can also mention typical sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc. We should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Provide typical range or how to find.
